hypothesis: The strongest candidate used prompt length and three regime indicators. A length-weighted medium regime preserves that structure while allowing a small cost increase from 21 to 22 tokens.

pcvs.expression: len(request.prompt_token_ids) if request.prompt_token_ids is not None else 0
pcvs.name: prompt_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Restores prompt length, which explained more variation than scheduler cardinality.

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and len(request.prompt_token_ids) == 9)
pcvs.name: nine_token_prompt

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and len(request.prompt_token_ids) == 10)
pcvs.name: ten_token_prompt

pcvs.expression: len(request.prompt_token_ids) if request.prompt_token_ids is not None and 12 <= len(request.prompt_token_ids) < 23 else 0
pcvs.name: medium_prompt_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Models medium-prompt overhead with modest length dependence, avoiding the previous ramp's doubling between 21 and 22 tokens.
